PC: Rapidly assesses the patient and performs a pelvic examination
Initiates patient monitoring (vital signs, cardiac monitor)
Stops applying traction on the head
Inserts or orders appropriate intravenous access (“two large-bore IVs”)
Initiates appropriate resuscitative techniques: Intravenous fluids Orders blood and blood products
Orders appropriate labs; must include, at least, the following: Type and cross match Comprehensive metabolic panel (or basic metabolic with liver enzymes/hepatic panel) Complete blood count PT/INR

Considers maneuvers to assist with a shoulder dystocia: Performs McRoberts maneuver Apply suprapubic pressure Performs the Woodscrew maneuver, if previous attempts to do not relieve the shoulder dystocia Delivery of the posterior arm is discussed and/or performed if prior maneuvers are unsuccessful
ICS: Calls for help and assigns team roles
